contract_clauses: Every UI artifact includes schema_version, kind, generated_at, source, and redaction_status
All UI model structs use bounded collections or carry explicit limit/cursor semantics
Workflow graph nodes and edges expose the master-required fields
Event rows expose seq, timestamp, run_id, step_idx, event_kind, status, evidence_digest, and attempt
Secret-sensitive values render only redacted status, taint, digest, and bounded summary
CLI emitted artifacts and UI model artifacts compare equal after canonicalization
vb_ui_model remains cold-path plain data and does not introduce Makepad, async runtime, HTTP, or runtime-core UI coupling
